nodes.label: Minor Erdtree Catacombs (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes route.

nodes.description: Post-Radahn catacomb entrance on the northern edge of the Wailing Dunes. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: War-Dead Catacombs
nodes.description: Grace inside the post-Radahn battlefield catacombs.

nodes.label: Putrid Tree Spirit (War-Dead Catacombs)
nodes.description: Putrid Tree Spirit at the end of the battlefield catacombs.

nodes.label: War-Dead Catacombs (post-boss state)
nodes.floor: Putrid Tree Spirit chamber return state
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Golden Seed and Redmane Knight Ogha.

nodes.label: Sellia Crystal Tunnel surface entrance
nodes.description: Mine entrance north-west of Sellia, with a separate Dragon-Burnt Ruins trap-chest arrival. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
nodes.description: Grace at the start of the crystal mine.

nodes.label: Fallingstar Beast (Sellia Crystal Tunnel)
nodes.description: Fallingstar Beast at the end of the crystal mine.

nodes.label: Sellia Crystal Tunnel (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing route.

nodes.label: Belurat Gaol surface entrance
nodes.description: Cave entrance by the lake west of Belurat, reached from Three-Path Cross. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Belurat Gaol
nodes.description: Grace immediately inside the optional gaol.

nodes.label: Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze (Belurat Gaol)
nodes.description: Boss chamber at the bottom of the hanging-jar and platforming route.

nodes.label: Belurat Gaol (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh.

nodes.label: Fog Rift Catacombs surface entrance
nodes.description: Catacomb mouth in the fog-filled ravine north of the Castle Front approach. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Fog Rift Catacombs
nodes.description: Grace at the start of the spike-trap catacombs.

nodes.label: Death Knight (Fog Rift Catacombs)
nodes.description: Death Knight behind the final elevator and fog door.

nodes.label: Fog Rift Catacombs (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Death Knight's Twin Axes and the catacomb reward route.

nodes.label: Rivermouth Cave surface entrance
nodes.description: Small cave entrance at the northern end of the Ellac River. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Rivermouth Cave
nodes.description: Grace just beyond the cave entrance.

nodes.label: Chief Bloodfiend (Rivermouth Cave)
nodes.description: Chief Bloodfiend beyond the Bloodfiend ritual pool.

nodes.label: Rivermouth Cave (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes and the return teleporter.

nodes.label: Scorpion River Catacombs surface entrance
nodes.description: Catacomb mouth at the far western end of the Scorpion River. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Scorpion River Catacombs
nodes.description: Grace at the beginning of the death-blight trap catacombs.

nodes.label: Death Knight (Scorpion River Catacombs)
nodes.description: Death Knight at the end of the death-blight and spike-trap route.

nodes.label: Scorpion River Catacombs (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Death Knight's Longhaft Axe and Cerulean Amber Medallion +3.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge Lava Intake surface entrance
nodes.description: Ruined forge entrance south-south-east of Castle Front, among massive ruined columns. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge Lava Intake
nodes.description: Grace just inside the forge entrance.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge Lava Intake (pipe route)
nodes.description: Internal pipe/lava transition before the forge's final anvil route.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge Lava Intake (reward state)
nodes.description: Reward endpoint for Smithscript Dagger and Anvil Hammer; no boss encounter exists here.

nodes.label: Taylew's Ruined Forge surface entrance
nodes.description: Forge entrance north-east of the Ancient Ruins Base grace. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Taylew's Ruined Forge
nodes.description: Grace at the beginning of the pipe-and-lava forge.

nodes.label: Taylew's Ruined Forge (reoriented pipe)
nodes.description: Lever state that reverses the central pipe and opens the final altar route.

nodes.label: Taylew's Ruined Forge (reward state)
nodes.description: Reward endpoint for Taylew the Golem Smith and Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones; no boss encounter exists here.

nodes.label: Cave of the Forlorn surface entrance
nodes.description: Cave entrance near Albinauric Rise in the Consecrated Snowfield. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Cave of the Forlorn
nodes.description: Grace at the beginning of the snowy cave.

nodes.label: Misbegotten Crusader (Cave of the Forlorn)
nodes.description: Misbegotten Crusader at the end of the cave.

nodes.label: Cave of the Forlorn (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Golden Order Greatsword route.

nodes.label: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs surface entrance
nodes.description: Catacomb entrance south-east of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
nodes.description: Grace at the start of the frost catacombs.

nodes.label: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist (Snowfield Catacombs)
nodes.description: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist beyond the lever and frost catacomb route.

nodes.label: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Great Grave Glovewort and Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak.

nodes.label: Yelough Anix Tunnel surface entrance
nodes.description: Frozen mine entrance below Yelough Anix Ruins. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Yelough Anix Tunnel
nodes.description: Grace at the bottom of the frozen mine lift.

nodes.label: Astel, Stars of Darkness (Yelough Anix Tunnel)
nodes.description: Astel at the end of the frozen mine.

nodes.label: Yelough Anix Tunnel (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Meteorite of Astel and the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone route.

nodes.label: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave surface entrance
nodes.description: Hero's Grave entrance reached across the elevated chain and bridge approach. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
nodes.description: Grace at the bottom of the Hero's Grave lift.

nodes.label: Ancient Hero of Zamor (Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave)
nodes.description: Ancient Hero of Zamor at the end of the shadow-light grave route.

nodes.label: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Zamor armor and curved sword route.

nodes.label: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs surface entrance
nodes.description: Catacomb entrance in the Flame Peak approach. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
nodes.description: Grace at the start of the multi-elevator catacombs.

nodes.label: Ulcerated Tree Spirit (Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs)
nodes.description: Ulcerated Tree Spirit at the end of the deep elevator route. The exact-name online map point shares the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs source record; its repeated Elphael formal candidate is retained as ambiguity, not used as a route edge.

nodes.label: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (post-boss state)
nodes.floor: Ulcerated Tree Spirit chamber return state
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Golden Seed and Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing 2 route.

nodes.label: Spiritcaller's Cave surface entrance
nodes.description: One-key Imp seal north-west of the First Church of Marika, across the frozen lake. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey; the raw source's formal candidate incorrectly points to the Road's End Spiritcaller Snail and is not used.

nodes.label: Spiritcaller's Cave
nodes.description: Grace inside the Stonesword-sealed cave.

nodes.label: Spiritcaller Snail summon - Godskin Apostle phase
nodes.description: Summoned Apostle phase of the Spiritcaller Snail encounter; this is not an independent cave boss or a separately coordinate-bound room. Both summon phases share the exact online Spiritcaller Snail boss-position record.

nodes.label: Spiritcaller Snail summon - Godskin Noble phase
nodes.description: Summoned Noble phase after the Apostle; both phases belong to the single hidden Spiritcaller Snail encounter and are not separately coordinate-bound rooms. Both summon phases share the exact online Spiritcaller Snail boss-position record.

nodes.label: Spiritcaller's Cave (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Godskin Swaddling Cloth and Black Flame Ritual.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past surface entrance
nodes.floor: South-west of Moorth Ruins / Moorth Highway
nodes.description: Rear structure entrance southwest of Moorth Ruins, reached by the torch-marked opening and ladder. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
nodes.description: Internal grace immediately inside the forge; this dungeon has no boss encounter.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (first door opened)
nodes.description: First lever state: the large door below the opening chamber is raised; the nearby reverse lever closes it again.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (heavy door lowered)
nodes.description: Second lever lowers the heavy door, exposing the side route to the Smithscript Cirque and the lever behind the door.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (Smithscript Cirque branch)
nodes.description: Optional side branch ending at Smithscript Cirque; the bottomless pit is a lethal one-way drop, so the route returns by the same corridor.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (altar lift raised)
nodes.description: Pull the lever behind the lowered door, stand on the rising door, and jump to the altar platform.

nodes.label: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (altar reward state)
nodes.description: No-boss completion endpoint containing Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword and Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone; leave by fast travel or backtrack.

nodes.label: Moorth Highway, South
nodes.description: Surface grace on the highway immediately outside the front approach to Fort of Reprimand.

nodes.label: Behind the Fort of Reprimand
nodes.description: Rear-side grace reached either from the northeastern Gravesite Plain spiritspring or through Castle Ensis's rear exit.

nodes.label: Fort of Reprimand
nodes.description: Interior fort grace discovered on the battlements after entering from the highway or rear route.

nodes.label: Fort of Reprimand front entrance
nodes.description: Front courtyard entrance from Moorth Highway, South; the lower dungeon and main hall branch are distinct from the battlement grace. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Fort of Reprimand sealed spiritspring route
nodes.floor: Northeastern poison pools / Ellac River descent
nodes.description: The sealed spring below the Gravesite Plain cliffs; unsealing it enables the high jump to the rear fort landing.

nodes.label: Black Knight Edredd (Fort of Reprimand)
nodes.description: Optional Black Knight boss in the fort main hall; drops Aspects of the Crucible: Wings.

nodes.label: Fort of Reprimand (post-Edredd state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state endpoint for the Crucible Wings reward and remaining fort exploration.

nodes.label: Bonny Gaol surface entrance
nodes.floor: South-east of Bonny Village / wooden bridge
nodes.description: Gaol entrance across the southern bridge from Bonny Village. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Bonny Gaol
nodes.description: Internal grace just inside the Bonny Gaol entrance.

nodes.label: Curseblade Labirith (Bonny Gaol)
nodes.description: Curseblade Labirith at the end of the gaol; reward is the Curseblade Meera spirit ash.

nodes.label: Bonny Gaol (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state endpoint for the gaol's boss reward and Night armor branch.

nodes.label: Scadu Altus, West
nodes.description: Upper grace used as the only practical approach to Fog Rift Fort; the fort is below the cliff and not reached by a flat road.

nodes.label: Fog Rift Fort lower entrance
nodes.floor: Cliff ledges below Scadu Altus, West
nodes.description: Vertical drop route from Scadu Altus, West through cliff ledges and a ladder into the lower fort. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Black Knight Garrew (Fog Rift Fort)
nodes.description: Optional Garrew encounter inside the lower fort; defeating him yields the Black Steel Greatshield.

nodes.label: Fog Rift Fort (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state endpoint for Garrew's shield and the upper fort item route; the online XYZ is the unique Fog Rift Fort map-point anchor, not a separate Boss coordinate.

nodes.label: Morne Tunnel surface entrance
nodes.description: Mine entrance at the southern end of the rocky chasm east of the Weeping Peninsula Minor Erdtree. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Morne Tunnel
nodes.description: The tunnel grace is at the bottom of the entrance lift, before the Misbegotten mine galleries.

nodes.label: Scaly Misbegotten (Morne Tunnel)
nodes.description: Scaly Misbegotten at the end of the tunnel; the encounter rewards the Rusted Anchor.

nodes.label: Morne Tunnel (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state endpoint for the Rusted Anchor and the mine's remaining smithing materials.

nodes.label: Fort Haight West
nodes.description: Grace southwest of Fort Haight, used as the staging point before the uphill fort approach.

nodes.label: Fort Haight surface entrance
nodes.description: Uphill approach from Fort Haight West through the ballista and soldier line to the fort gate. The online XYZ is a named dungeon-location anchor, not a verified exact surface-mouth survey.

nodes.label: Godrick Knight (Fort Haight)

onlineTextLocation.locationClaim: Blood-obsessed Godrick Knight on Fort Haight's upper level.
onlineTextLocation.reason: The fixed online map-point and Boss-position snapshots contain Fort Haight but no uniquely named Godrick Knight coordinate.

nodes.description: Blood-obsessed Godrick Knight on the upper level; defeating it yields Bloody Slash but is not a hard gate to the tower chest.

nodes.label: Fort Haight upper tower (Dectus Medallion left)
nodes.description: Upper-tower chest endpoint for Dectus Medallion (Left); the Knight can be bypassed with a risky run or distraction.

nodes.label: Fort Haight (post-Godrick Knight state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state endpoint for Bloody Slash and Kenneth Haight's liberated-fort quest step; the online XYZ is the unique Fort Haight map-point anchor, not a separate Boss coordinate.

nodes.label: Forsaken Graveyard
nodes.floor: Darklight Catacombs exit / Abyssal Woods threshold
nodes.description: The graveyard immediately beyond Jori's arena and before the forbidden forest entrance.

nodes.label: Stranded Graveyard
nodes.description: Starting grace above the Cave of Knowledge pit; the western lift exits to The First Step.

nodes.label: Cave of Knowledge
nodes.description: Optional tutorial branch below Stranded Graveyard, entered by the hole beside the seated spirit.

nodes.label: Soldier of Godrick (Cave of Knowledge)

onlineTextLocation.locationClaim: Tutorial boss at the end of the Cave of Knowledge.
onlineTextLocation.reason: The fixed online snapshots contain the Cave of Knowledge location anchor but no uniquely named Soldier of Godrick Boss-position record.

nodes.description: Tutorial boss at the end of Cave of Knowledge; the encounter is optional because the player can use the outer lift instead.

nodes.label: Cave of Knowledge (post-boss return state)
nodes.description: Return ledge after Soldier of Godrick; the Strength! gesture is obtained before returning to the graveyard.

nodes.label: Stranded Graveyard surface lift
nodes.description: Lift beyond the Stranded Graveyard doors; it bypasses the optional tutorial and reaches the overworld starting grace.

nodes.label: Foot of the Four Belfries
nodes.description: Grace at the foot of the western Liurnia hill; the path climbs to The Four Belfries.

nodes.label: The Four Belfries
nodes.description: Hilltop grace beside three Sending Gates and the Imbued Sword Key chest.

nodes.label: Chapel of Anticipation (opening chapel)
nodes.description: Opening island chapel and starting plane before the Grafted Scion encounter.

nodes.label: Grafted Scion (Chapel of Anticipation)
nodes.description: Opening boss gate; the first-run route exits by the death/cutscene or the nearby fatal fall, while a later visit can clear the boss.

nodes.label: Chapel of Anticipation (post-Scion state)
nodes.description: Cleared opening courtyard with the Grafted Scion rewards available before the fatal drop/return transition.

nodes.label: Precipice of Anticipation Sending Gate
nodes.description: One-way Sending Gate labelled Precipice of Anticipation; it consumes an Imbued Sword Key when first unlocked.

nodes.label: Chapel of Anticipation (return visit)
nodes.description: Return arrival from the Four Belfries; the side chapel door is available for Stormhawk rewards. The plane has no ordinary walkable mainland bridge.

nodes.label: Chapel of Anticipation side-door rewards
nodes.description: Return-only side door route for Stormhawk King and Stormhawk Deenh; it is separate from the opening boss arena.

nodes.label: Melina Roundtable invitation scene
nodes.description: Event node at an eligible grace where Melina offers the Roundtable Hold invitation; this is a scene transition, not a walkable location.

nodes.label: Table of Lost Grace
nodes.description: Isolated hub grace. Roundtable Hold is not present as a normal overworld landmass and is accessed by map fast travel after Melina's invitation.

nodes.label: Agheel Lake North
nodes.description: Northern lake grace east of Gatefront; it is also a valid early-world Melina interaction landmark.

nodes.label: Seaside Ruins
nodes.description: Southern lake/coast grace near the Yura and Agheel approach; it is a surface branch, not an underground entrance.

nodes.label: Church of Dragon Communion
nodes.description: Island grace reached through Coastal Cave's rear passage; the island is a separate surface plane segment from the mainland coast.

nodes.label: Summonwater Village Outskirts
nodes.description: Staging grace west of the flooded Summonwater Village and its optional Tibia Mariner arena.

nodes.label: Tibia Mariner (Summonwater Village)
nodes.description: Optional field boss reached east from the Summonwater Village Outskirts grace; the village route itself is not sealed by this boss.

nodes.label: Summonwater Village (post-Tibia Mariner state)
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for Deathroot and the eastern Green Turtle Talisman cellar branch.

nodes.label: Waypoint Ruins Cellar
nodes.description: Cellar grace below the Waypoint Ruins; the Mad Pumpkin Head gate and Sellen route are underground relative to the surface ruins.

nodes.label: Mad Pumpkin Head (Waypoint Ruins)
nodes.description: Cellar boss gate below the Waypoint Ruins; defeating it opens the room beyond for Sorceress Sellen.

nodes.label: Waypoint Ruins Cellar (post-boss state)
nodes.description: Cleared cellar state with the Sellen dialogue room available.

nodes.label: Warmaster's Shack
nodes.description: Stormhill shack grace on the road between Stormhill Shack and Saintsbridge; night state can replace Bernahl with the Bell Bearing Hunter.

nodes.label: Ailing Village Outskirts
nodes.description: Northern grace above Ailing Village and Callu Baptismal Church; reached by an uphill branch from Castle Morne Rampart.

nodes.label: Beside the Crater-Pocked Glade
nodes.description: Central peninsula surface grace near the crater-pocked glade; it is kept separate from the Tombsward cave and catacombs layers.

nodes.label: Isolated Merchant's Shack
nodes.description: Western-coast merchant shack grace reached south from Fourth Church of Marika; the merchant and coastal field are an optional surface branch.

nodes.label: Tombsward
nodes.description: Surface grace on the Tombsward route, distinct from Tombsward Cave and Tombsward Catacombs below the peninsula.

nodes.label: Boilprawn Shack
nodes.description: Lake-shore grace north of Scenic Isle and the Blackguard Big Boggart encounter.

nodes.label: Folly on the Lake
nodes.description: Western lake grace used as the approach toward the Village of the Albinaurics and the flooded shallows.

nodes.label: Village of the Albinaurics
nodes.description: Hidden ravine settlement below the lake plateau; the Omenkiller route is internal to this lower settlement layer.

nodes.label: Rose Church
nodes.description: Rose Church island south of Raya Lucaria; Varré's quest location is kept as a surface landmark rather than fabricated as a Site of Grace.

nodes.label: Omenkiller (Village of the Albinaurics)
nodes.description: Optional Omenkiller gate at the far end of the village; it does not block the overworld descent into the settlement.

nodes.label: Village of the Albinaurics (post-Omenkiller state)
nodes.description: Cleared village state after the optional Omenkiller encounter.

nodes.label: Jarburg
nodes.description: Lower cliff settlement reached by descending the tombstone ledges east of Liurnia; it is not on the same elevation as the eastern lake shore.

nodes.label: Revenger's Shack
nodes.description: Western Liurnia shack grace and Edgar the Revenger invasion branch.

nodes.label: Slumbering Wolf's Shack
nodes.description: Surface grace at the rear of Lakeside Crystal Cave, where Latenna's shack branch begins after the cave boss.

nodes.label: Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts
nodes.description: Northern plateau staging point below the Frenzied Flame Village and Church of Inhibition route.

nodes.label: Church of Inhibition
nodes.description: High northern church grace reached by the back slope of Frenzied Flame Village; the approach crosses a Madness hazard and can spawn Festering Fingerprint Vyke.

nodes.label: Ancient Snow Valley Ruins
nodes.description: Frozen river grace after Zamor Ruins and before the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook branch.

nodes.label: Snow Valley Ruins Overlook
nodes.description: Overlook beside the broken bridge and the route toward Freezing Lake/Heretical Rise.

nodes.label: First Church of Marika
nodes.description: Church grace on the southeastern Freezing Lake route, separate from Church of Repose and Foot of the Forge.

nodes.label: Church of Repose
nodes.description: Flame Peak church grace on the approach from Foot of the Forge; the Bloody Finger Okina encounter is a local hazard.

nodes.label: Hidden Path to the Haligtree
nodes.description: Secret lift/dungeon grace reached by using the Haligtree Secret Medallion at Grand Lift of Rold; it is not the normal Mountaintops lift result.

nodes.label: Apostate Derelict
nodes.description: Northwestern Snowfield church grace northwest of Ordina, with the Latenna-related reward branch.

nodes.label: Capital Rampart
nodes.description: First capital-rampart grace after the Draconic Tree Sentinel gate, before the East Capital Rampart interior route.

nodes.label: Hermit Merchant's Shack
nodes.description: Cliffside merchant grace east/northwest of Outer Wall Battleground; its Bell Bearing Hunter state is an optional night hazard.

nodes.label: Minor Erdtree Church
nodes.description: Church grace at the end of the southeast path from Outer Wall Phantom Tree, between the Sealed Tunnel and West Altus tower route.

nodes.label: Fallen Ruins of the Lake
nodes.description: Central lake grace reached from Folly on the Lake by crossing the broken tower and ruin islands; it is the western approach node for Temple Quarter.

nodes.label: Temple Quarter
nodes.description: Grace on the outer edge of the flooded Temple Quarter ruins, reached north/northeast from Fallen Ruins of the Lake and serving as a central lake branch.

nodes.label: Crystalline Woods
nodes.description: Northwestern academy-island grace above the Academy Crystal Cave route; the adjacent roads branch east to Sorcerer's Isle and southeast to the cave mouth.

nodes.label: Sorcerer's Isle
nodes.description: Northern lake-island grace east of Crystalline Woods; the island's turtle puzzle is local and does not gate the grace, while the route continues southeast toward the bridge supports.

nodes.label: East Gate Bridge Trestle
nodes.description: Bridge-underside grace reached from the northern lake-island route; it provides the distinct eastward connection to Gate Town North beneath the collapsed bridge.

nodes.label: Mausoleum Compound
nodes.description: Upper Uld Palace Ruins grace reached by climbing northwest from the Ruined Labyrinth side; it is separated from the lower ruins by a cliff/route transition.

nodes.label: Altar South
nodes.description: Southern Moonlight Altar grace before Chelona's Rise; the three-wise-beasts puzzle is local to the nearby tower and does not gate the grace.

nodes.label: Cathedral of Manus Celes
nodes.description: Interior cathedral grace northeast of Moonlight Altar; the hole and Ranni interaction below are modeled as a separate quest interaction, not as a prerequisite for reaching the grace.

nodes.label: Gateside Chamber
nodes.description: Optional side-room grace near the castle gate, reached from the courtyard/bridge return route; it is not collapsed into Stormveil Main Gate or Stormveil Cliffside.

nodes.label: Artist's Shack
nodes.description: Limgrave Artist's Shack between Agheel Lake North and Third Church of Marika; it is deliberately separate from the identically named Liurnia grace.

nodes.label: Artist's Shack
nodes.description: Liurnia Artist's Shack on the eastern cliff north of Liurnia Highway North; it is deliberately separate from the Limgrave grace with the same display name.

nodes.label: Ghostflame Dragon (Greatbridge North)
nodes.description: Optional field boss in the Gravesite Plain lake west of the Greatbridge, North grace. The coordinate is the online map-point record; the route node remains separate from the grace.

nodes.label: Greatbridge North Ghostflame Dragon cleared state
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Greatbridge North Ghostflame Dragon arena; no post-boss grace is fabricated.

nodes.label: Ghostflame Dragon (Moorth Highway)
nodes.floor: Ruined encampment south of Moorth Ruins
nodes.description: Optional field boss at the ruined encampment south of Moorth Ruins, reachable from Moorth Highway, South. The online map point is retained as game-world XYZ evidence.

nodes.label: Moorth Highway Ghostflame Dragon cleared state
nodes.floor: Ruined encampment south of Moorth Ruins
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Moorth Highway Ghostflame Dragon arena; the nearby grace remains the return anchor.

nodes.label: Ghostflame Dragon (Cerulean Coast)
nodes.description: Optional field boss south of the Cerulean Coast grace. The route is modeled as an approach from the grace, not as a Euclidean-nearest-point claim.

nodes.label: Cerulean Coast Ghostflame Dragon cleared state
nodes.description: Cleared-state node for the Cerulean Coast Ghostflame Dragon arena; no extra grace is invented.

nodes.label: Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader
nodes.description: Ringleader's Evergaol at the north-western tip of Moonlight Altar; Alecto drops Black Knife Tiche. The online XYZ is retained as a coordinate evidence sidecar, not as a flat-distance route.

nodes.label: Ringleader's Evergaol cleared state
nodes.description: Cleared-state node after Alecto; Black Knife Tiche remains an achievement reward outcome.

nodes.label: Godefroy the Grafted
nodes.description: Golden Lineage Evergaol at the south-western edge of Altus Plateau; one Stonesword Key is required and Godefroy drops Godfrey Icon.

nodes.label: Golden Lineage Evergaol cleared state
nodes.description: Cleared-state node after Godefroy; the Godfrey Icon reward is represented by the achievement location group.

edges.mode: Altus Plateau to Bridge of Iniquity
edges.note: Northern Altus approach into Mt. Gelmir; Seethewater is kept as a later alternate branch.

edges.mode: Bridge of Iniquity to First Mt.Gelmir Campsite
edges.note: Climb past the Abductor Virgin encampment to the first Gelmir campsite.

edges.mode: Mt. Gelmir upper climb
edges.note: Ladders and the mountain ascent reach Road of Iniquity.

edges.mode: Road of Iniquity to Volcano Manor
edges.note: The long mountain road reaches the Volcano Manor entrance grace.

edges.mode: Temple of Eiglay portal route
edges.note: After Godskin Noble, the lift/lava route and sending gate reach Audience Pathway.

edges.mode: Rykard audience approach
edges.note: Audience Pathway is the final grace before the God-Devouring Serpent/Rykard fog gate.

edges.mode: Rykard completion
edges.note: The Rykard post-boss grace is separate from Audience Pathway.

edges.mode: Liurnia Lake Shore to Academy Gate Town
edges.note: North/northeast lake route to the academy town checkpoint.

edges.mode: Liurnia Lake Shore to Laskyar Ruins
edges.note: Ride northwest through the lakebed and ruined structures to the Laskyar Ruins grace; the academy sending gate is modeled as a separate interaction branch.

edges.mode: Liurnia Lake Shore Spiritspring to Highway South
edges.note: Use the eastern lake Spiritspring to climb to the highway; this vertical connection is not a flat lake walk.

edges.mode: Liurnia Highway South to North
edges.note: Follow the east Liurnia highway north past the broken bridge and soldier camps to the North grace.
